title: Moroccan Potatoes in Gratin
description: A Chinese-inspired take on the classic moroccan dish, featuring roasted moroccan potatoes in a creamy gratin.
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.
In a large bowl, combine the roasted potatoes and chopped onion.
Season with chinese five-spice powder, if using.
Transfer the potato mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Pour the gratin over the potatoes and top with additional grated cheese, if desired.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
